title: sme credit memo preparation: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 13 h 30 min of staff time per application

steps.task: Collect 3 years of statements, tax returns and bank statements; chase missing items
Index the package and check it against the document checklist
Key 3 years of financials and tax returns into the spreading tool
Read 12 months of bank statements; reconcile deposits to reported revenue
Compute DSCR, leverage, liquidity and global cash flow with guarantors
Run KYC, sanctions screening and business and personal bureau pulls
Write the 10–20 page credit memo for committee
Review the memo, send back edits, sign off for committee

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 2 h 30 min of human time per application

steps.task: OCR runs first; label each document and send the RM a missing-items list
Spread 3 years of statements and tax returns, every figure with a page citation
Categorise 12 months of transactions; flag overdrafts, NSFs and odd deposits
Compute DSCR, leverage and liquidity in code; run sanctions screening and bureau pulls
Approve the spread and every flagged item before analysis starts
Test against credit policy; list risks, mitigants, exceptions and covenant ideas
Draft the memo section by section in the bank's committee template
Tie every number in the memo back to the approved spread and source page
Edit, sign and send to committee. The committee makes the credit decision
